subject: FinBridge runtime outage: data provenance & evidence request
messages:
From: Mary Jenkins <mary.jenkins@finbridge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: sre_oncall@finbridge.com
Date: 2028-04-12T09:15:00Z
Subject: Major latency/error spike — need logs & retention window

Hi Vivek,

We observed a large latency spike and 5xx error surge affecting live payments between 08:40-09:05 PT this morning. Our engineers captured trace IDs and some sample request IDs but we need formal evidence for our audit and to unblock a regulatory report.

Questions: can Redwood provide a timestamped export of request/response logs, token-level error rates, and any runtime trace IDs for that window? What's your default retention for full request payloads vs. aggregated metrics? Also, please confirm whether any sensitive fields are redacted automatically or whether the raw request bodies are retained.

We may need an official pack for our compliance team by EOD. Please advise the quickest path.

Thanks,
Mary Jenkins
Director, Site Reliability
FinBridge

Attachment: sample_trace_ids.txt (text)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Mary Jenkins <mary.jenkins@finbridge.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-12T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Major latency/error spike — need logs & retention window

Hi Mary — thanks for flagging and for the sample IDs. We're on it. Internal note: looping in CS (Monica), infra (Aditya, Rishi) and Legal (Lauren) because this will be an evidence package.

Quick answers up front:
- We can export request/response logs and trace IDs for the interval (08:40-09:05 PT).
- Default retention: raw request/response payloads are retained for 30 days by default; aggregated metrics and traces retained for 90 days.
- Sensitive fields: we have PII masking at ingestion for configured customers; however, raw payloads are kept in encrypted storage when retention is enabled. We will not redact anything unless instructed by FinBridge/legal.

Mary — do you want the raw payloads (full bodies) or a redacted export for the compliance pack? Also, please confirm the exact list of trace IDs you want included.

Action plan I propose:
1) Quarantine a snapshot of the tenant's logs for 08:30-09:30 PT and mark them under legal hold.
2) Produce an evidence pack (logs + trace list + runtime metrics) and provide a secure Drive link.
3) If legal requires, we can prepare a redacted version and a manifest describing items redacted.

I'll hold on step 3 until we have guidance from FinBridge or Redwood legal. Monica/Aditya/Rishi — can you confirm ETA for the snapshot and whether we need formal legal hold paperwork? Lauren — please advise on sharing rules/NDA needs.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-12T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Major latency/error spike — need logs & retention window

Vivek / team —

I initiated a log preservation runbook (attached) and started an immediate snapshot for FinBridge. ETA for full export (raw + trace metadata) is ~3 hours. Steps we're taking:
- Preserve tenant's runtime logs (08:30–09:30 PT) in an isolated S3 bucket with access limited to incident responders.
- Generate per-request metadata (traceID, requestID, latency_ms, status_code) as CSV.
- Include runtime router traces and node-level metrics for the interval.

Customer preference: Mary — if you want redacted outputs, tell us which fields to redact (PII, account numbers, card tokens). Otherwise we'll deliver raw payloads through a secure link and redact only on request.

Attachment: runbook_evidence_collection_v2.pdf (pdf)

-Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-12T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Major latency/error spike — need logs & retention window

Quick technical update (quoting Vivek's plan):

> Quarantine a snapshot of the tenant's logs for 08:30-09:30 PT and mark them under legal hold.

Done. I've isolated the bucket (redwood-evidence/finbridge/20280412-0830-0930) and set an ACL that prevents deletion. For the evidence pack we'll include:
- request_response_dump.gz (line-delimited JSON, full bodies)
- trace_metadata.csv (traceID, spanID, node, latency_ms, error_flag)
- runtime_node_metrics.json (cpu/gpu, queue_depths)

Notes/asks:
1) Do not perform automatic redaction or truncation before Legal signs off. If FinBridge requests redaction, we'll compute a manifest describing exact changes.
2) If Regulatory/legal needs chain-of-custody, we should generate a signed manifest (timestamped hash list). I can produce trace_samples_20280412.csv (attached) for initial review.

Attachment: trace_samples_20280412.csv (csv)

-Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mary Jenkins <mary.jenkins@finbridge.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T12:40:00Z
Subject: RE: FinBridge runtime outage: data provenance & evidence request — executive brief

Team / Mary — short exec brief to capture actions and asks for leadership:

Summary: FinBridge experienced a latency + 5xx surge 08:40–09:05 PT impacting payments. We have quarantined tenant logs, isolated an evidence bucket, and generated initial trace samples.

What we've preserved:
- Full request_response_dump.gz (08:30–09:30 PT) — stored encrypted in redwood-evidence/finbridge/20280412-0830-0930
- trace_metadata.csv and trace_samples_20280412.csv
- Node-level runtime metrics for the period

Open asks for exec/legal approval:
1) Approve sharing the full raw payloads with FinBridge under an NDA (recommended) OR request a redacted export (specify fields).
2) Approve generation of a signed chain-of-custody manifest for the evidence pack (recommended if this will be used for regulatory audit).
3) Confirm whether we should provision a short-term retention extension beyond the default 30 days (I propose hold until 2028-05-12 unless legal says otherwise).

If approved, we'll upload the pack to a secure Drive folder and share an expiring link with FinBridge. Monica — we'll hand off to you for the customer communication once legal confirms.

Mary — can you confirm whether FinBridge will accept an NDA and whether they want raw or redacted payloads?

Thanks — Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
